name: Habitas Alula
insider_take: A desert sanctuary where ancient history meets modern luxury in Saudi Arabia's archaeological wonderland
whats_special: Habitas Alula is nestled within UNESCO World Heritage site AlUla, home to the ancient Nabataean city of Hegra with over 100 well-preserved sandstone tombs dating back 2,000 years. The property features sustainable desert architecture that blends seamlessly with the dramatic rock formations and canyons of the Ashar Valley.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise hot air balloon experience over the ancient tombs - it's only available seasonally and offers unparalleled views of this archaeological treasure that was closed to tourism until 2019.
dont_miss: The nearby Elephant Rock (Jabal AlFil), a natural sandstone formation that's particularly stunning at sunset, and the AlUla Old Town ruins with traditional Hijazi architecture. The hotel also offers exclusive stargazing experiences in one of the world's darkest sky locations.
pros: Unique desert glamping experience in UNESCO World Heritage site
Sustainable eco-luxury design with minimal environmental impact
Extraordinary stargazing opportunities in pristine desert environment
Access to ancient archaeological wonders and rock formations
